classification.difficultyReason: Select the ratio component matching each given quantity and scale it; the hardest parts additionally interpret a combined total or a difference between the two quantities.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
Apples : bananas $=3:5$.
There are 12 apples.
Find the number of bananas.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=12\text{ apples}\\1\text{ part}&=12\div3=4\text{ fruits}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times4=20\text{ bananas}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt:
Apples : bananas $=3:5$.
There are 35 bananas.
Find the number of apples.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}5\text{ parts}&=35\text{ bananas}\\1\text{ part}&=35\div5=7\text{ fruits}\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times7=21\text{ apples}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt:
Apples : bananas $=3:5$.
There are 12 apples.
Find the total number of fruits.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=12\text{ apples}\\1\text{ part}&=12\div3=4\text{ fruits}\\\text{Total parts}&=3+5=8\\8\text{ parts}&=8\times4=32\text{ fruits}\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt:
Apples : bananas $=3:5$.
There are 35 bananas.
Find how many more bananas than apples there are.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}5\text{ parts}&=35\text{ bananas}\\1\text{ part}&=35\div5=7\text{ fruits}\\\text{Difference in parts}&=5-3=2\\2\text{ parts}&=2\times7=14\text{ fruits}\end{align*}$$
There are 14 more bananas than apples.

children.label: e
children.prompt:
Red : blue $=5:2$.
There are 7.5 L of blue paint.
Find the red paint required.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2\text{ parts}&=7.5\text{ L}\\1\text{ part}&=7.5\div2=3.75\text{ L}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times3.75=18.75\text{ L}\end{align*}$$
18.75 L of red paint is required.

children.label: h
children.prompt:
Pine : oak $=6:7$.
There are 21 m of oak.
Find the pine required.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}7\text{ parts}&=21\text{ m}\\1\text{ part}&=21\div7=3\text{ m}\\6\text{ parts}&=6\times3=18\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
18 m of pine is required.

children.label: i
children.prompt:
Two connected road sections are in the ratio $3:4$.
The first is 24 km.
Find the combined distance.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=24\text{ km}\\1\text{ part}&=24\div3=8\text{ km}\\\text{Total parts}&=3+4=7\\7\text{ parts}&=7\times8=56\text{ km}\end{align*}$$

children.label: j
children.prompt:
Milk : water $=3:4$.
There are 10 cups of water.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}4\text{ parts}&=10\text{ cups}\\1\text{ part}&=10\div4=2.5\text{ cups}\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times2.5=7.5\text{ cups}\end{aligned}$$
7.5 cups of milk is required.
